<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Alison has confirmed that the meeting has been booked for Thursday at 14:30.
My next and final step is to send the confirmation email to the four partners.
The task specifies that I am the one to send the confirmation email.
The task is complete when the booking has been created and the confirmation email has been sent. Alison has created the booking. I will now send the confirmation email.
The email should contain the day and start time of the meeting.
Day: Thursday
Start time: 14:30
The body of the email should be a simple confirmation of the meeting.
I will use the `send_confirmation_email` function to do this. After this, the task should be complete.I have confirmation from Alison that the meeting is booked. All that's left is for me to send the confirmation email to the partners.

function.name: send_confirmation_email
function.arguments: {"day":"Thu","start":"14:30","body":"This is a confirmation that the partners' meeting has been scheduled."}
